svg.title: NPA lifecycle
svg.desc: Stages from standard asset to loss asset, and gross NPA less provisions equals net NPA for HDFC Bank FY25.

svg.text: From a missed EMI to net NPA (HDFC Bank, 31 March 2025, ₹ crore)

svg.text: Net NPA is what is left after the bank's own provisioning judgement — which is why two banks with the same gross NPA can report different net NPA.
